portrait_requirements.lighting: warm candle key upper-left, cool bounce upper-right
portrait_requirements.art_direction: gouache painterly fantasy, coherent with P2 Vesper/Oracle/Corvin, no AI-generated typography

images.description: A solemn androgynous adult masked archivist in ash-grey ceremonial robe, brass Ledger seal at collar, face half-hidden beneath a geometric visor; upright symmetrical silhouette, muted warm gold/cold slate.
Adult human bookie with expressive round spectacles, auburn hair pulled back, ink-stained fingers and ochre merchant waistcoat, alert mischievous expression.
Adult dark-haired rakish noble gambler with narrow scar, black plum velvet, burgundy lapel, confident sideways smile and sharp profile.
Adult imposing stern bald or closely shaven bailiff, broad black mantle, dark brass judicial crest, heavy jaw, cold analytical gaze.
Adult contemplative monastic woman with green-grey hood, thin silver chain, gentle but calculating eyes and simple woven vestments.
Adult pale sleepless registry clerk, coal-dark vest, brass spectacles, parchment strips tucked at breast, thin silhouette, lamp-worn under-eyes.
Adult wiry dark-skinned dock courier with rolled canvas coat and rope scarf, copper ear cuff, windswept cropped hair, wary determined look.

new_act3_art: Use gold monograms as explicit placeholders for seven Act III opponents, separate portrait generation later; no falsely claimed completed art.
